notes: Android-based mobile OS: graphene + OS. The hard part is graphene, which Wikipedia records as /ˈɡræfiːn/ — GRA-feen, rhyming with 'seen', not graph-een and not gra-FEEN; then the two letters O-S. It trended the week of 2026-11-09 with the Motorola partnership and the Dutch bank ASN blocking non-Google Android — two front-page stories, and the name gets mangled in both threads.

German loanword, stress on the second syllable and an sh where the spelling shows an s: guh-SHTALT, never GES-talt. Developers meet it in Gestalt pattern matching (Python's difflib) and in design-system writing about perceptual grouping; GestaltX, an iOS MobileGestalt editor, was the top new GitHub repository the week of 2026-11-09 (6k+ stars).
